# Argo: GitHub Copilot entry point

Read and follow [the shared repository instructions](../AGENTS.md) before working.
For installation, free discovery/demo, real audits, recovery, and interpreting
results, read [the agent guide](../docs/agent-guide.md).

Distinguish operating Argo from changing its code. Fixture replay is not a real
audit; do not start real model calls or optional target execution without approval.
Keep shared procedures in `AGENTS.md` and the guide rather than duplicating them
here. This file is a repository-wide entry point, not an automatic file import.
